contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return how many pages are needed to hold items, with at most pageSize items per page. Empty input needs zero pages.
contract.domain: Items is an integer from 0 through 100000; pageSize is an integer from 1 through 1000.

inputRoles.pageSize: maximum number of items per page

contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
